help.title: Help
help.publish_q: How do I post a product?
help.publish_a: Go to the "Post" tab, choose a category, add photos, a title, a description and a price, and confirm so it shows up in the feed.
help.contact_q: How do I contact a seller?
help.contact_a: Open a product's detail page and tap "Contact" to start a direct chat with the seller inside the app.
help.verification_a: From your profile you can start verification by uploading your university ID or a government ID. An administrator reviews the request and activates the matching badge.
help.report_q: How do I report a problem?
help.report_a: You'll find the report option on a user's profile or inside a chat. Describe the situation and the support team will review it.
help.support_a: Write to soporte@mercaditoum.site and we'll reply within 48 business hours.

safety.verify_profile_t: Check the profile before meeting up
safety.verify_profile_d: Review the rating, the reviews and whether the seller has the verification badge before arranging a handover.
safety.public_places_t: Meet in public areas on campus
safety.public_places_d: Prefer busy places like libraries, cafeterias or building entrances. Avoid isolated areas or spots off campus.
safety.check_product_d: Make sure the item matches the listing and works properly before completing the payment.
safety.no_prepayment_t: Be wary of upfront payments outside the app
safety.no_prepayment_d: Don't transfer money upfront to external accounts. Do the exchange in person, product and payment at the same time.
safety.report_suspicious_d: If someone asks for personal data, pressures you to leave the app, or looks like a scam, report them from their profile or contact support.
